```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class BookmarksTable extends Component
{
    // Public properties to be used in the template and methods to manipulate them
    public $bookmarks = [];
    public $newBookmark = '';

    // Method to fetch bookmarks from the database
    public function loadBookmarks()
    {
        $this->bookmarks = DB::table('bookmarks')->get();
    }

    // Method to save a new bookmark
    public function saveBookmark()
    {
        if (!empty($this->newBookmark)) {
            DB::table('bookmarks')->insert(['url' => $this->newBookmark]);
            $this->newBookmark = '';
            $this->loadBookmarks();
        }
    }

    // Method to delete a bookmark
    public function deleteBookmark($id)
    {
        DB::table('bookmarks')->where('id', $id)->delete();
        $this->loadBookmarks();
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.bookmarks-table');
    }
}
```
